## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly at finish.

- Fonts: `@fontsource/press-start-2p`, `@fontsource/pixelify-sans`.
- Save system: 3 localStorage save slots (`starfall_vale_saves_v1`).
- World is one seamless outdoor map plus separate procedural mine floors (depth 1–5).
- "Marxies": invented shy star-sprite creatures caught by offering Moonberries; produce Stardust; count toward ending relic.
- Ending: restore Starfall Shrine using 5 lights/relics (harvest crop, catch Starlight Koi, mine Astral Shard, befriend Marxy, earn 2 hearts with a villager).
